decisions.decision: 23 quick replies in a collapsible '💬 ข้อความด่วน (23)' panel, closed by default, vertical scroll max-height 176px, below input/emoji
decisions.why: Horizontal strip rejected: hides ~20 of 23 phrases behind a gesture and shows about 2 at a time; panel keeps input and send always visible at 375px

decisions.decision: Send button is .btn.primary 'ส่ง' in the same form, right of input on row 1; emoji wrap to row 2 on mobile
decisions.why: Shares sendChat with Enter; rejected full-width input row because it would push send below

decisions.decision: Toggle stays enabled when silenced or quota 0; only pills are disabled, with an explanatory note inside the panel
decisions.why: Player can see why; rejected disabling the toggle (silent dead control)

decisions.decision: Panel stays open after a tap; open state survives render() as a client var
decisions.why: Players send several lines; rejected auto-close (extra taps)

decisions.decision: No canvas.json/.dc.html; self-contained HTML mockup, no new tokens, no design-system files
decisions.why: Orchestrator asked for HTML; project has no docs/design-system and scope is a change to an existing screen

summary: Chat bar design: send button + collapsible 23-phrase panel, states S1-S7 mockup at 375px.
